authorization: User explicitly requested 尝试改进方法本身 after previous external-resource block.
hypothesis: A global linear anatomical projection may miss smooth nonlinear feature-output relationships. An additive cubic-spline surrogate may improve frozen-classifier behavior reconstruction beyond both the existing linear AD4 and a flexible scalar reference.
scope: Method-development experiment within approved PARES-AD; not FW6, a new disease, clinical validation or human study.

AD4_ADDITIVE.model: Per-input cubic B-splines, 3 quantile knots, include_bias=False: 4 bases per input, 16 total; scale bases, fit Ridge; constant extrapolation

REF1_FLEXIBLE.model: Cubic B-splines, 15 quantile knots, include_bias=False: 16 total; same scaling, Ridge and tuning; constant extrapolation

tuning: For each family/configuration and outer target domain, use only other development domains. Select alpha by inner leave-one-domain-out mean absolute error, pooling inner participants equally. All spline knots/scalers refit inside each inner training split. Tie selects larger alpha. Linear baselines fixed at original alpha1.
evaluation: Outer development domain held out from surrogate fitting and tuning. Each participant averaged across available configurations, then equal weight per participant. No loss filtering or sparse-domain deletion.
upstream_limitation: Existing development classifier predictions and cross-fitted concepts are frozen artifacts. Underlying classifiers/reference preprocessing across other folds are not fully nested for this new surrogate CV. This is conditional method-development evidence, not a new end-to-end independent validation. Prior confirmation and repeat-scan outcomes are already known.
primary: Participant-average absolute error of reconstructed frozen classifier logit.
development_continuation_gate: Both contrasts: at least 10% relative MAE reduction, paired participant percentile 95% interval lower bound above0, and at least7/9 configurations with lower MAE. This pragmatic method-development threshold is not a clinical minimum effect.

bootstrap.limitation: Intervals conditional on all fitted surrogate/source artifacts; do not capture model-selection uncertainty.

second_stage_if_gate_passes: Freeze source-selected per-domain/configuration models before reconstructing the existing 402 repeat-scan pairs. Evaluate change MAE against original AD4 and REF1 plus new flexible REF1 on all3269 pairs, with the same joint practical and directional thresholds; strictly exploratory reuse, not independent confirmation. No source or confirmation refit after viewing pair metrics.
if_gate_fails: Stop this additive candidate; retain all development results. Do not automatically try additional knots, interactions, ROIs or unfreeze confirmation data to select a variant.
interpretation: Better behavior approximation is an intermediate methodological property. It does not establish diagnosis, causal fidelity, error-review gain, human utility, or achievement of the75-80 scientific goal.
preservation: New script and output directory only. Existing raw data, models, predictions, endpoints and manuscript conclusions unchanged.
